component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.documents.transmittals
component.documentation: The transmittal listener, synchronous, in the transaction of the change that fires it: issues a transmittal on creation, numbered from the series registered for transmittals, with each document it lists checked as a current revision its issuer may read; creates, as the issuer, a receipt beside it for each recipient; lets each receipt be answered once, acknowledged or returned with a comment, by its recipient alone; refuses any other change to either, and their deletion and trash but by an administrator. No Automation operation: a person reaches it by creating a transmittal and by saving their receipt, as every client does. Every refusal marks the transaction for rollback.
